profile.headline: Father | Software Engineer | PHP Developer | DJ | Music Producer
profile.summary:
Web Developer with experience in  HTML, Javascript, Jquery, Ajax, PHP, MySQL, Magento, Code Igniter MVC Frameworks.

Specialties: HTML, Javascript, Jquery, Ajax, PHP, MySQL, Magento, CodeIgniter, Windows, Linux, OS X

positions.title: Sr. Leader Web Developer
positions.description:
• Build E-Commerce store using Big-Commerce
• Build web based ERP/CRM system from scratch using PHP/MySQL
• Integrate different vendor’s API to maintain catalog/orders sync 
• Integrate Avalara into Bigcommerce for Tax calculations
• Integrate ShipperHQ into Bigcommerce for International shipping
• Ensure all products have accurate dimensions and weight for shipping purpose
• Integrate EBay API so products can be sold on EBay
• In charge of all social media accounts
• Graphic Design to create banner/promotions 
• Create videos for social media  
• Create Google/Facebook Ads to run campaigns 
• Integrate Twilio API for SMS promotions
• Integrate Mailchimp for email promotions
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing · E-Commerce · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Sales · Social Media · Web Development · BigCommerce

positions.title: Senior Magento Web Developer
positions.description:
• Manage Magento 2.3 website, responsible for coding, testing, merge requests and code
migration to production environments
• Write/update PHP scripts to manage transfer of data between Microsoft Dynamics and MySQL
• Write/update scripts that import/export product data, orders, shipping, email opt-ins for third-parties such as Channel Advisor, Bronto, etc.
• Usage of Git for version control
• Familiarity with Jira Tracking Software, Jitterbit and RabbitMQ
• Being part of the migration from Magento 1 to Magento 2 and consolidate thirteen sites into one multi- store installation
• Help testing implementation of Sales Force and Acumatica to work with Magento
• Use of CodeIgniter MVC framework to develop internal applications
positions.insights: Skills: Model-View-Controller (MVC) · jQuery · MySQL · Jira · HTML5 · Magento · UNBXD · Slack · CodeIgniter · PHP · CSS3 · JavaScript · Microsoft Teams · GitHub · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
• Develop Online stores for print services using Page DNA Framework 
• Develop and Support purls using LAMP
• Give Support to custom PHP System built for Southeast Toyota
• Give Support to WordPress websites
• Familiarity with Git version control
positions.insights: Skills: PURLs · jQuery · MySQL · HTML5 · LAMP · PHP · JavaScript · WordPress · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PageDNA · Git

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Develop sites in Drupal 5 and 6 on a LAMP environment
• Build both features and provide maintenance for large-scale Drupal applications.
• Supported high-traffic websites using multiple caching layers, including Memcached and Varnish
• Utilized version-control systems to manage software development across multiple website environments
• Deep familiarity of Subversion, including command-line interface
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · Varnish · MySQL · Secure Shell (SSH) · Drupal · PHP · Subversion · Memcached · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Vim
